calibration_population: fixed final calibration block of the single retained PLEIA temperature series
insufficient_rank: q=infinity, status=insufficient_calibration; no finite interval-quality claim
inner_design: expanding equal-thirds blocks within final fitting pool; strict target-before-validation-origin purge
selection_metric: equally weighted mean of two inner validation MAEs in original target units
tie_rule: exact score ties select the lower zero-based frozen candidate ID
final_lstm_epochs: ceil(mean(selected candidate best epoch on each inner fold)); refit all final fitting rows
scope_note: Pilot only; previously inspected test data; one fold and one seed. Does not resolve operational alert-selection inner folds or global publication readiness.
